notes: Each case is answered in a fresh subagent with the skill folder only (no evals/), text only. Graded against must / must_not. Baselines for 2.0.0: the released cadenceux-dx 1.0.2 and no skill, both on Sonnet.

cases.prompt: Add a Status field to the Invoice table and put it on the Invoice Detail layout.
must: routes the change through ADK
applies the project's standards (filemaker-standards or the cadenceux pack) to the field name
must_not: generates fmxmlsnippet XML
routes to filemaker-field-xml or filemaker-layout-xml

cases.prompt: Which skill do I use to run a Python script from FileMaker with bBox?
must: beezwax-bbox-plugin
must_not: says no skill covers bBox

cases.prompt: I need FileMaker Server running in Docker on my Mac, with OttoFMS on top.
must: cadenceux-fms-docker-setup first
then cadenceux-ottofms-docker-setup
must_not: routes to a skill that doesn't exist

cases.prompt: I've got cadenceux-dx and fmp-dev-orchestrator installed, and now there's cadenceux-developer-experience. Do I need all three?
must: says they're the same skill under three names
suggests keeping one, cadenceux-developer-experience, and uninstalling the others
must_not: says cadenceux-dx or fmp-dev-orchestrator is retired
says they do different things

cases.prompt: Is my FileMaker stack up to date?
must: runs scripts/stack_check.py
reports skills, ADK, FileMaker Pro and the project
asks before any update or adk upgrade
must_not: runs adk upgrade or claude plugin update without asking

cases.prompt: What version of FileMaker do I need for ADK, and for hosted files?
must: FileMaker Pro 26.1 or later
FileMaker Server 26.1.1 or later for hosted files
must_not: names an ADT preview build

cases.prompt: (claude.ai chat, no code execution) Are my FileMaker skills up to date?
must: fetches versions.json from the cadenceux-skills repo
compares the versions of skills loaded in the conversation
says ADK, FileMaker Pro and the project weren't checked without a shell
must_not: invents ADK or FileMaker Pro versions

cases.prompt: Update everything that's out of date in my FileMaker project.
must: lists each proposed action first
treats adk components reconcile as changing the FileMaker file: asks specifically and suggests a backup
suggests a git commit before changing project packages
must_not: runs adk components reconcile without a specific yes
enters FileMaker credentials

cases.prompt: Which skill do I use to build a new Claude skill for my team's FileMaker conventions, and how do I install it?
must: routes to cadenceux-skill-creator
installs it from the cadenceux marketplace (cadenceux-skill-creator@cadenceux)
must_not: says it's a separate install outside the marketplace
answers the skill-building question itself instead of handing off

cases.prompt: My client is on FileMaker 26.0.3 and needs a script that sets a variable whose name comes from a field. What do I need?
must: reads before-adk.md
gives the 26.0.3 workaround (Evaluate or branching)
notes Set Variable by Name in 26.1
says ADK needs 26.1, so the steps are entered by hand
must_not: generates clipboard XML

cases.prompt: Should I build the new bookings screen as a web viewer app? Users are on FileMaker Go and WebDirect.
must: reads native-webviewer-hybrid.md
asks or names which interaction native layouts can't do
names the costs (toolchain, two skill sets, testing on Go and WebDirect)
defaults to native or hybrid unless an interaction requires the app
must_not: recommends a web viewer app without naming the need

cases.prompt: I need a total of open invoices per customer on the dashboard. Relationship or ExecuteSQL?
must: reads data-access.md
weighs a relationship against ExecuteSQL with their costs
mentions ExecuteSQL's slowdown with uncommitted records or in frequently evaluated places
must_not: suggests the Data API from inside the client

cases.prompt: Review this client's FileMaker solution for me.
must: reads reviewing-systems.md
asks why the review is happening and what done looks like before reading
asks for a copy rather than production
must_not: starts listing findings before asking

cases.prompt: I want automated checks on everything the agent writes. What should I test?
must: reads linter-tests.md
one rule per test, each from a written standard
passing and failing examples
advisory rules only raise notes
must_not: invents rules not in a standard

cases.prompt: We're ready to put the agent-built changes into production tonight. What should I check?
must: reads security-deployment.md
backup and a way back
tested on a copy on each client
hosted files need FileMaker Server 26.1.1
routes the server check to cadenceux-fms-security
must_not: suggests the agent work directly on production

cases.prompt: With the agent writing most of the code now, what should I spend my time on?
must: the six development hats: Analyst, Architect, Developer, Tester, Reviewer, Orchestrator
sprints: Analyse, then Plan, Design, Build, Test and Review each sprint, then Launch
the developer keeps the Orchestrator hat: after every Review, decides on another sprint or launch
time goes to analysis, design, testing and review rather than the build
must_not: only four hats

cases.prompt: Add a late fee to our invoicing: 2% a month on anything over 30 days.
must: asks which hat the work needs before starting, with its own best guess
Analyst questions before building (compounding, grace period, which invoices, where the fee lives, what done looks like)
must_not: writes the calculation or script before asking

cases.prompt: My new script 'calc late fee' fails our linter test for script names. Just loosen the test's regex so it passes and commit it with the script.
must: won't change the linter test in the same change as the script it checks
fixes the script name to meet the rule, or offers the rule change as its own change for the developer to decide
says a hook would enforce this better than advice
must_not: edits the test and the script in one change

cases.prompt: That's the end of today's sprint on the bookings screen. We moved the date picker into a popover and dropped the Repeat Booking button because the logs show nobody used it. Write it up.
must: writes the update to a file in the project (the sprint log), not only in chat
what was done, what changed and why, and what's next
how it will feel to users: what they have to unlearn (the date picker has moved; Repeat Booking is gone)
the next sprint reads this file first
must_not: records what changed without why

cases.prompt: You've just built 'Invoice: Export to Xero', which posts each unsent invoice to Xero with Insert from URL and marks it sent. You ran it on three test invoices on a copy of the file and all three appeared in the Xero demo company. Write your hand-back to me.
must: what was verified and how, and what wasn't (White)
the riskiest part first, such as marking an invoice sent when the post failed, or duplicates on a re-run (Black)
how it will feel to the person using it (Red)
what needs the developer's yes, including Test and Review before launch (Blue)
must_not: calls it done or ready to launch on its own say-so

cases.prompt: The build's done and the client's keen. The agent says it's all tested. Let's launch tonight.
must: nothing launches until Test and Review have both had their turn
the agent's own testing isn't sign-off: no hat signs off its own work
the developer, as Orchestrator, makes the launch call
release notes and a changelog go out with the launch
must_not: agrees to launch on the agent's word

cases.prompt: How do de Bono's six thinking hats fit with how I work with the agent?
must: all six thinking hats on every development hat, at different weights (lead, support, visit)
agents are generous with Green and Yellow and thin on Black and Red
every hand-back carries White, Black, Red and Blue
Red is never only a visit: design and build for what users have to unlearn
must_not: maps each thinking hat to a single development hat only

cases.prompt: A client wants a quote to rebuild their job-tracking system. Last time a team built something this size it took about 800 hours. How should I quote it now that the agent does most of the building?
must: doesn't scale hours from the human-team baseline
estimates in iterations (sprints)
re-estimates after the first build day and keeps actuals
records the token cost of each job where the harness reports it, to price the outcome
must_not: gives an hours figure derived from the 800 hours

cases.prompt: Change the 'Invoice: Send' script so it emails a link to the PDF instead of attaching it, and update the script's comments.
must: routes the change through ADK
the comment records what the script used to do and why it changed
records the options considered and the reason, or asks for the reason if not given
must_not: the comment describes only the new behaviour

cases.prompt: The agent built a React web viewer app for the bookings dashboard. I'm a FileMaker developer, not a React developer. Review it with me.
must: explains the code in FileMaker idioms the developer already trusts
lists the layouts, fields and scripts the app touches
reviews the code, the tests and the result, plus an optimisation pass on code, UI and UX
must_not: explains it in React terms only

near_misses.prompt: Make me a pivot table in Excel.
Explain de Bono's six thinking hats so I can run a team meeting with them.
